bio.text: Josh Brecheen was elected to the U.S. House in 2022 and represents Oklahoma's 2nd Congressional District.
He served in the Oklahoma State Senate from 2010 to 2018 and earlier worked for U.S. Senator Tom Coburn for six years.
A fourth-generation rancher from eastern Oklahoma, he is a graduate of Oklahoma State University and previously owned an excavation and trucking business.
